alkin: King Tralossk never liked Alkin, but gave him his own command in hopes he would one day get himself killed. That never happened: Alkin went on to a long and glorious career, much to the King's displeasure.
andra: King Tralossk made Andra, a mere human, undergo trials of knowledge before allowing her to lead one of his armies. She missed not a single question. With every answer right, the King had no choice but to accept her.
broghild: Broghild's grandfather first tamed wild Wyverns for use as flying scouts above the Tatalian Lowlands. He passed the secrets of handling them to Broghild's father, who then passed that knowledge in turn to Broghild himself.
korbac: Humans of Erathia know Korbac as the 'hero who saved the scholar, Xanthor'—though how true the story is remains uncertain. He has nevertheless proven his bravery on more than one occasion during his service in Tatalia.
mirlanda: In her youth, Mirlanda toyed with the dark arts until she saw that such a path often led to self-destruction. She now walks a fine line between good and evil, careful that neither grows more powerful than the other.
tazar: During a six-month border war with Krewlod, Tazar led a small force to make a stand at a Tatalian outpost. Nearly five times their number attacked; for more than eight days, his soldiers held until reinforcements arrived.
wystan: Wedded to King Tralossk's eldest daughter, Wystan is next heir to Tatalia's throne. For now, he is content to serve and learn from the King, waiting until the time is right to kill his mentor and assume the throne.
